data.narrative:
Zettascale is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), which has raised $3M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 11 private and 3 public comparables in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including Series A peers SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, and d-Matrix.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $3M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $8M. Peer-median anchoring uses three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables with a median valuation of $2.3B and a range of $2.0B–$11.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied: while the public semiconductor universe (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) trades at a 18.4x price-to-sales median, Zettascale's revenue is not disclosed, preventing P/S derivation. 

These two methods produce a triangulated range of $6M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around product-market fit, IP defensibility, and the stage gap between seed and the Series A comparables. The stage-progression result ($8M) anchors a conservative floor; peer median valuation substantially reflects the sector's venture appetite but assumes Zettascale will achieve comparable traction. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency, technical differentiation relative to the named peer set, and timing to Series A.
